features: Ergonomic Design: The ergonomic design of both the keyboard and the mouse prioritizes comfort, minimizing strain during prolonged usage.
Keys: This slim-designed keyboard is equipped with 105 keys, including a Rupee key (₹), catering to users in regions using the Indian Rupee currency.
Multimedia keys: The ZEB-Judwaa 880 includes 12 integrated multimedia keys for media control and enhancing overall usability.
3 buttons: The mouse also comes with 3 buttons, including the right button, left button, and middle scroll.
High-Precision: The high-precision optical sensor embedded in the mouse contributes to accurate and smooth tracking.
Plug-and-Play: The ZEB-Judwaa 880 offers hassle-free Plug & Play functionality, enabling easy setup through a USB interface for a simple and dependable connection.
Cable Length: The 1.3-meter cable length provides users with flexibility in positioning the keyboard and mouse, accommodating various desktop setups.
description: ZEBRONICS JUDWAA 880 Wired USB Keyboard & Mouse Combo, Plug & Play, 105 +12 Integrated Multimedia Keys, 3 Button Mouse, 1000 DPI, High Precision, Advanced Optical Sensor
